Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Temba Bavuma and Reeza Hendricks will open the batting for South Africa. Bhuvneshwar Kumar will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! Even though the target might be less for South Africa, the pitch is not the easiest to bat on and so it is going to be a tough chase for the visitors.  India does have a quality blowing attack and a capable of defending this. Can they do so? We will find out.

Anrich Nortje says that hitting the hard lengths seemed to be the best bet on this deck and just a few balls they didn't execute well that went the distance. Adds that a bit of grass was taken off since the last time they were here and they had to adapt to the pitch conditions which they did well.

South Africa started the innings perfectly by grabbing a wicket in the first over. They lost their way after that and leaked a few runs. But they came back stronger and grabbed wickets at regular intervals, and capitalized on the same. They put a lid on the run flow in the middle phase. It was their seamers that were doing the job for them. Kagiso Rabada and Wayne Parnell both grabbed a wicket each and were economical as well. Anrich Nortje was a tad bit expensive but he picked up two wickets in his spell.

After being put into the bat first India lost Ruturaj Gaikwad in the first over itself. But post that, Ishan Kishan displayed his magic, and he along with Shreyas Iyer put 42 runs at the end of the Powerplay. Ishan Kishan perished soon after that, but Shreyas Iyer carried on with Rishabh Pant at the other end. Once Rishabh Pant departed, wickets fell in a heap, and runs had completely dried up. 150 was looking a bit far-fetched for India. But Dinesh Karthik and Harshal Patel scored 30 runs in the last two overs and helped India put a fighting total. They have given their bowler's plenty to fight with.

A good finish from India has helped them to put a respectable and competitive total on the board. Thanks to their new, finisher, Dinesh Karthik. He along with Harshal Patel scored 30 runs in the last two overs and guided India to close to 150. It's been a good bowling show from the visitors but they would be disappointed on losing control in the last couple of overs. Nevertheless, they have done a good job with the ball here!

Just the single to end but the damage was done before it. Good slower delivery, full and outside off. Karthik looks to lift it over covers but edges it towards short third man. The batters cross and India finish with 148/6!

SIX! Back-to-back from Dinesh Karthik! Fuller this time, around off. Karthik gets it off the bottom part of the bat but gets enough on it to launch it over the long off fence for a maximum. 17 off the over with one ball to go.
SIX! BOOM! Pretorius goes short and outside off, the ball sits up nicely and Dinesh Karthik hammers it over long off for a biggie.
length this time, around off. Harshal Patel slices it over point and picks up a single, turns the strike over to DK.
Good comeback from Pretorius! Change of pace and it's the slower yorker outside off as well. Patel gets completely deceived by the lack of pace and it will be a dot ball.
FOUR! Overpitched and punished! Dwaine Pretorius serves it in the slot around off, Harshal Patel holds his shape and thumps it over wide mid off for a boundary.

FOUR! Delicate touch from DK! This is bowled on a length and around off, Karthik just opens the face of the bat at the last moment and uses the pace of the delivery to run it fine. The ball runs away into the third man fence.
WIDE! This is angled down the leg side and a wide is called.
FOUR! Much needed for India and Dinesh Karthik gets it. Banged in short and over middle, Karthik manages to pull it behind square and beats the man at the backward square leg fence.
Anrich Nortje sees Harshal Patel backing away and follows hi with a length ball. Patel is able to work it on the off side and picks up a single.
Quick single! Length again, around off. Dinesh Karthik punches it towards mid off and sets off for the run, good running.
Beaten! An off-pace delivery, outside off, on a length. Dinesh Karthik looks to push this on the off side but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Tad shorter, outside off. Harshal Patel steers it down to third man for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Harshal Patel pushes it towards cover for a single.
Length again, around off. Harshal Patel blocks it out towards cover.
Shaping away, length ball, outside off. Harshal Patel looks to have a poke at it but he misses.
FOUR! Nicely done! Much-needed boundary for India! A low full toss, outside off. Harshal Patel opens the face of the bat and guides it past point for a boundary.
Another good-length delivery, outside off. Dinesh Karthik pushes it towards cover for a single.
Swing and a miss! Shorter, wide of off. Dinesh Karthik looks to cut this away but he misses.
Harshal Patel walks out to bat.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! Axar Patel's struggling innings comes to an end! Anrich Nortje sends him back with an absolute thunderbolt of a delivery! A length ball, nipping back in on middle, at around 146 clicks. Axar Patel looks to flick this but he gets beaten. The ball goes on to knock the middle pole over.
Bangs it short, around middle. Dinesh Karthik miscues his pull shot towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Swing and a miss! On a length, outside off. Dinesh Karthik tries to scoop this but he misses.
On a length, around middle and leg. Axar Patel works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Anrich Nortje drops it short again, outside off. Axar Patel pushes it off the back foot towards the fielder at cover.
Back of a length, around middle. Dinesh Karthik pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Single taken!
Shorter and outside off. Dinesh Karthik cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length, around middle and leg, this one nips back in. Dinesh Karthik tries to flick this but he misses.
On a length, around middle and off. Axar Patel flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.

In the air....and safe! A length delivery, around off. Dinesh Karthik chips it towards mid off. Temba Bavuma there collects the ball on a bounce. He has a shy at the non-striker's end but he misses. THe ball rolls away and the batters sneak in a run.
Much fuller now, around middle and off. Axar Patel drives it down to long off. Single taken!
Length ball, around middle. Dinesh Karthik gets a leading edge towards third man for a single.
Leg bye! Angling in on a length, around middle. Dinesh Karthik misses his flick. The ball goes off his pads towards square leg and the batters sneak in a leg bye!
Beaten! Slower one again, on a length, outside off. Dinesh Karthik leans to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Wide! Slower, fuller, down the leg side. Dinesh Karthik misses his flick. Wide called!
Back of a length, outside off. Axar Patel knocks it towards mid off for a single.
Length ball delivery, outside off. Axar Patel opes the face of the bat and dabs it towards backward point.
Wide! Wayne Parnell errs in line and serves it down the leg side. Axar Patel leaves it alone. Wide called!
Length ball, angling in on a length, around middle and leg. Dinesh Karthik works it away to mid-wicket for a single.
Pitches it up again, around off. Dinesh Karthik lunges forward and dabs it to backward point.
Fuller ball, outside off. Dinesh Karthik presses forward and taps it toward cover for a single. He gets off the mark straightaway!
Dinesh Karthik is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! South Africa continue to grab wickets at regular intervals and India are in a spot of bother now. Dwaine Pretorius is the one who gets rid of Shreyas Iyer. A length ball, outside off, sharing away. Shreyas Iyer stays in his crease and tries to push this on the off side. But the ball goes off the outside edge towards the keeper. Heinrich Klaasen pouches it safely. India have lost half their side now.
Commentary.Howout: c Heinrich Klaasen b Dwaine Pretorius

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, around middle. Axar Patel looks to flick this on the leg side, but he gets a leading edge towards cover for a single.
Fuller, slower, on middle. Axar Patel pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Edgy runs! But India won't mind that! A length ball, outside off. Axar Patel tries to cut this but the ball goes off the inside edge away from the leg pole towards fine leg for a boundary.
Slower ball, on a length, around middle. Shreyas Iyer flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Pitched up ball, around middle. Shreyas Iyer knocks it to long on for a single.
Fuller one, around middle. Axar Patel works it away towards square leg for a single.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Wayne Parnell comes back into the attack and sends back the dangerous, Hardik Pandya! A lovely delivery from Wayne Parnell. a length ball, tailing in, around middle and leg, that keeps a touch low as well. Hardik Pandya tries to cut this away but misses as the ball stays low. The ball goes on to knock the leg pole over. Axar Patel walks out to bat now.
Slower ball, shorter, around middle. Shreyas Iyer pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

PUT DOWN! What an effort from Temba Bavuma! WOW! A very, very tough chance goes down. A fuller ball, around middle. Hardik Pandya makes room and drives it uppishly towards cover. Temba Bavuma there, springs to his right, gets his right hand to the ball, but fails to grab it.  One run!
Top delivery! A slower, yorker, around off. Shreyas Iyer digs it out towards deep square leg for a single.
Another flatter ball, shorter again, around off. Hardik Pandya once again cuts it towards cover. Good comeback from Keshav Maharaj after being hit for six on the first ball!
Shorter now, spinning away, around off. Hardik Pandya makes room and slaps it to the fielder at cover.
Flat now, quicker, around the pads. Shreyas Iyer flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Ful, tosses it up, around middle. Hardik Pandya knocks it to long on for a single.
Flatter, quicker, on the pads. Shreyas Iyer hangs back and tucks it towards square leg for a single.
SIX! That was not hit from the middle of the bat but that still goes all the way! A loopy all, full and around off. Shreyas Iyer steps down the wicket and smashes it over long off for a biggie.
FOUR! Hardik Pandya ends the over with a four and ruins a good over for Tabraiz Shamsi. A shorter ball, wide of off. Hardik Pandya slashes it past point for a boundary.
Fuller, quicker, spinning into the right-hander. Hardik Pandya pushes it towards cover.
Width on offer now, shorter ball. Shreyas Iyer hangs back and cuts it past point for a single.
Back of a length again, around off. Shreyas Iyer pushes it back to the bowler.
Wide! Shorter ball, wide of off, that one stays low as well. Shreyas Iyer leaves it alone. Wide called!
Shorter ball, darting it on the pads. Hardik Pandya flicks it towards short fine leg for a single.

A fuller ball, spinning in, down leg. Hardik Pandya looks to sweep but he misses and gets hit on his back pad. A huge appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no! Temba Bavuma opts for a review! No bat involved there, confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracking indicates that was missing the wickets. The on-field decision stands. South Africa lose a review.
Flatter now, quicker, around middle. Hardik Pandya works it away towards short fine leg for a single.
Shorter ball, spinning away, around off. Shreyas Iyer pushes it towards cover. Single taken!
Tosses it up again, around middle and leg, full in length. Shreyas Iyer tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Another tossed up ball, darting it on the pads. Hardik Pandya flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle and off. Hardik Pandya presses forward and blocks it out.
Hardik Pandya walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Keshav Maharaj strikes on his very first ball! This is smart bowling from him. He gets rid of the Indian skipper now. A loopy ball, fuller and wide of off stump. Rishabh Pant decides to take him on straightaway. He charges down the track, stretches to reach the ball, and throws his bat at it. The ball goes off the splice towards deep point. Rassie van der Dussen once again pouches it safely. Huge wicket this for South Africa!
Commentary.Howout: c Rassie van der Dussen b Keshav Maharaj

Commentary.Commentary: It will be spin from the other end as well. Keshav Maharaj comes to bowl.

SIX! This is even better! A four followed by a six! Another loopy ball, full, around off. Shreyas Iyer once again shimmies down the pitch and tonks it straight down the round for a biggie. 14 runs off the over.
FOUR! Top shot! Perfectly placed! A fuller ball, around middle, tosses it up. Shreyas Iyer dances down the track and heaves it towards cow corner for a boundary.
Wide! Down the leg side. Shreyas Iyer leaves it alone. Wide called!
Spinning away, tad shorter, outside off. Rishabh Pant stays back and chops it past point for a run.
Loopy ball, fuller in length, around the leg pole. Rishabh Pant tries to flick this but he misses and gets hit on his pads.
Fuller now, around middle and leg. Shreyas Iyer steps down the pitch and flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tabraiz Shamsi begins with a short ball, spinning away, outside off. Rishabh Pant punches it off the back foot towards deep cover. One run taken!
Tabraiz Shamsi comes into the attack.
Shorter ball, slower in pace, outside off. Shreyas Iyer hangs back and tries to slap this on the off side but he gets beaten.
A leg cutter, shorter ball, around off. Rishabh Pant taps it towards extra-cover. Single taken!
Pitched up delivery, around middle and leg. Shreyas Iyer works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, around the off pole. Rishabh Pant dabs it towards point and takes a single.
Slower ball, on teh pads, on a length. Shreyas Iyer flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Swing and a miss! A shorter ball, shaping away, outside off. Shreyas Iyer looks to cut this away but he misses.

Down the leg side, tad shorter. Shreyas Iyer looks to pull it but he manages to get only a glove on it. The ball lands short of Heinrich Klaasen behind the stumps, who fumbles to stop the ball. Single taken.
Another short ball, around middle. Rishabh Pant taps it towards square leg and takes a single.
Rishabh Pant comes to the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Anrich Nortje strikes and Ishan Kishan's fine knock comes to an end! Wicket at a good time for South Africa. It's the short that has done the trick. Anrich Nortje hits the deck hard, at around 147 clicks, around middle. Ishan Kishan pulls this one but he is a tad bit late on his shot. The ball flies high and goes straight down the throat of Rassie van der Dussen at deep square leg who takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Rassie van der Dussen b Anrich Nortje

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Lovely shot! Short and width on offer. Ishan Kishan hangs back and cuts it hard past point for a boundary.
On a length, around middle and leg. Shreyas Iyer works it away towards deep square leg for a single.
Fuller delivery, around middle and leg. Ishan Kishan looks to heave this on the leg side, but the ball goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
On a length, around middle. Shreyas Iyer works it away towards the fielder at mid-wicket. India are 42 for 1 at the end of the Powerplay!

DROPPED! A very tough chance though! Top effort from Wayne Parnell! A fuller ball, around middle. Ishan Kishan heaves it towards the right of mid on. Wayne Parnell dives full stretch to his right, sticks both his hands out, and gets his hands to the ball, but he can't get hold of it. Single taken!
Fuller ball, down the leg side. Ishan Kishan backs away and flicks it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Tad shorter from over the wicket, outside off, Shreyas Iyer dabs it with soft hands towards cover and takes a single.
Another back-of-a-length delivery, around middle. Ishan Kishan this time miscues his pull towards mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! KABOOM! Ishan Kishan greets Dwaine Pretorius with a biggie! A shorter ball, tad slower, around middle. Ishan Kishan dispatches this one over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Dwaine Pretorius comes into the attack.
Fuller ball again, around middle. Ishan Kishan knocks it to mid on and takes a single.
A low full toss, around the leg pole. Ishan Kishan makes room and drives it towards cover-point.
On a length, outside off. Ishan Kishan blocks it towards cover.
FOUR! Crunched! Ishan Kishan makes room and Wayne Parnell follows him and serves a shorter ball, down the leg side. Ishan Kishan backs away and pulls it past mid-wicket for a cracking boundary.
Back of a length, an off-cutter on this occasion, around off. Shreyas Iyer dabs it towards the point region and takes a single.
On a length, outside off. Shreyas Iyer guides it to the fielder at short third man.
Length ball, around middle. Ishan Kishan looks to dab it on the off side but the ball goes off the inner half onto his pads. 13 runs off Anrich Nortje's first over.
Tad slower now, at around 126 clicks, on a length, darting it on the pads. Ishan Kishan looks to flick this but he misses, the ball brushes off his pads and goes to the keeper.

SIX! There he goes again! Six more for India and Ishan Kishan! Second in the over. A shorter ball, around middle. Ishan Kishan gets on top of the bounce and pulls it over dep square leg for another maximum.
Much fuller now, outside off, at around 148.5 clicks. Ishan Kishan knocks it to the fielder at mid on.
SIX! Bang! He made that look so easy! On a length, attacking the stumps, at around 143 clicks. Ishan Kishan uses his wrists and flicks it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Anrich Nortje begins with a length ball, outside off. Shreyas Iyer looks to block this but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man. Single taken!

Excellent stop! Tad shorter, around middle. Ishan Kishan pulls it towards mid-wicket. Rassie van der Dussen there dives to his right, sticks his right hand out, and makes a terrific stop. Saved a certain boundary there!
A length ball, angling in around middle. Shreyas Iyer looks to flick this but he gets a leading edge away from point. Single taken!
Fuller ball, angling in around middle. Shreyas Iyer chips it towards mid on. The fielder there collects the ball on a bounce.
On a length, outside off. Shreyas Iyer dabs it towards point.

Ohh..that does not carry! A length ball, outside off, tad slower. Shreyas Iyer tries to block this with soft hands, but the ball goes off the outside edge and falls just short of Heinrich Klaasen behind the stumps.
Good-length delivery, tailing back in around middle, at 137.9 clicks. Shreyas Iyer blocks it out.
Another length ball, outside off. Ishan Kishan makes room, steps down the track and taps it to cover again.
A length delivery, around middle and off, at around 130 clicks. Ishan Kishan pushes it towards the fielder at cover.
An overpitched delivery, angling in around middle. Shreyas Iyer flicks it past mid on. Three taken!
FOUR! Lovely shot! Shreyas Iyer gets off the mark in style! Fuller ball again, outside off. Shreyas Iyer drives it firmly and uppishly over cover for a boundary.
Outside off, shorter ball, shaping away. Shreyas Iyer looks to push this off the back foot but he misses.
Fuller ball, around middle and leg. Ishan Kishan flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Who will bowl from the other end? Wayne Parnell it is!
Shortish ball, around middle. Shreyas Iyer flicks it towards mid-wicket. 3 runs and a wicket off the first over! Good start for South Africa!
Shreyas Iyer is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! What a start for South Africa and Kagiso Rabada! That's a big wicket. Ruturaj Gaikwad walks back in the first over. India in trouble early on! A fuller ball, outside off. Ruturaj Gaikwad leans and tries to drive this away from his body but the ball goes off the outside edge towards point. Keshav Maharaj takes a good catch there.
Commentary.Howout: c Keshav Maharaj b Kagiso Rabada

Commentary.Commentary: Wide! Too short on this occasion, that's gone over Ruturaj Gaikwad. Heinrich Klaasen does well to grab the ball. Wide called for height.
Another length delivery, darting it on the pads. Ishan Kishan works it away towards fine leg and takes a single. Ishan Kishan is off the mark as well!
On a length, darting it on the thigh pads, at 134.4 clicks. Ruturaj Gaikwad flicks it to square leg for a single. Ruturaj Gaikwad and India are up and running!
Back of a length again, around off, at 135.6 clicks. Ruturaj Gaikwad taps it towards cover once again.
Kagiso Rabada begins with a shorter ball, outside off. Ruturaj Gaikwad gets on his toes and pushes it to the fielder at cover.

The Barabati Stadium has a pre-match bell as well and Naveen Patnaik, the Odisha chief minister, will ring the bell. We are now ready for action to begin! The umpires have made their way out in the middle. The players of South Africa are in a huddle before they take their field positions. Ruturaj Gaikwad and Ishan Kishan will open the batting for India. Kagiso Rabada will begin with the ball. Let's go!

Kagiso Rabada is down for a chat. He says that he is trying to stay as fit as possible, and he is trying to give full intensity in the game. Adds that the wicket looked difficult to bat on in the previous game, but India scored over 200 and they were taken aback, but they knew the pitch is good for batting and the batters did a phenomenal job. However, there are still areas to improve. Mentions that they will try to do the same thing, only tweak a few things as a team.

Rishabh Pant the captain of India says that they would have bowled first as well, as they have not played here, but it does matter. Adds that the track looks nice and they want to put a score on the board. They said they did not really do anything wrong in the first game, it was only about executions. Informs they are playing the same team.

Temba Bavuma the skipper of South Africa says that they will bowl first as they don't know how the wicket will play. Mentions that it was easier to bat second in the last game, they can chase anything with smaller boundaries. Informs that they two forced changes. Quinton de Kock has a hamstring injury, so Heinrich Klaasen comes in, Reeza Hendricks is in for Tristan Stubbs as well.

India (Unchanged Playing XI) - Ishan Kishan, Ruturaj Gaikwad, Shreyas Iyer, Rishabh Pant (C/WK), Hardik Pandya, Dinesh Karthik, Axar Patel, Harshal Patel, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Avesh Khan, Yuzvendra Chahal.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Reeza Hendricks (In for Tristan Stubbs), Temba Bavuma (C), Dwaine Pretorius, Rassie van der Dussen, David Miller, Heinrich Klaasen (WK) (In for Quinton de Kock), Wayne Parnell, Kagiso Rabada, Keshav Maharaj, Anrich Nortje, Tabraiz Shamsi.
TOSS - South Africa have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first!

PITCH REPORT -  Deep Dasgupta is near the pitch. He says that the pitch is the center of the ground, so equal dimensions on both sides The pitch has a fair bit of grass, and a few cracks, so it means not much for the seamers or even for the spinners. Mentions that the wicket is a bit two-paced and also there are fewer chances of dew playing a factor in this game. Informs that the par score is around 160 to 170, the pitch looks tacky but 160 should be good enough.
